title: The Festive Evening
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6fa174fdf0ed7a199b9c338432628d2824b432fc.png)

It's the end of July – the time when a festive evening is held at Jelly Castle! Guests from all over the kingdom gather here to discuss new trends in the world of confectionery. Yet some of the things discussed here are not supposed to be disclosed to the general public: the information can cause discord in the kingdom of Sweetland in case it turns out to reach the wrong hands. So it's a necessity to not let any uninvited guests in.

There are 26 entrances in Jelly Castle, enumerated with uppercase English letters from `A` to `Z`. Because of security measures, each guest is known to be assigned an entrance he should enter the castle through. The door of each entrance is opened right before the first guest's arrival and closed right after the arrival of the last guest that should enter the castle through this entrance. No two guests can enter the castle simultaneously.

For an entrance to be protected from possible intrusion, a candy guard should be assigned to it. There are $*k*$ such guards in the castle, so if there are more than $*k*$ opened doors, one of them is going to be left unguarded! Notice that a guard can't leave his post until the door he is assigned to is closed.

Slastyona had a suspicion that there could be uninvited guests at the evening. She knows the order in which the invited guests entered the castle, and wants you to help her check whether there was a moment when more than $*k*$ doors were opened.

## Input

Two integers are given in the first string: the number of guests $*n*$ and the number of guards $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 26$).

In the second string, $*n*$ uppercase English letters $*s*_{1}*s*_{2}... *s*_{*n*}$ are given, where $*s*_{*i*}$ is the entrance used by the $*i*$-th guest.

## Output

Output «`YES`» if at least one door was unguarded during some time, and «`NO`» otherwise.

You can output each letter in arbitrary case (upper or lower).

## Note

In the first sample case, the door A is opened right before the first guest's arrival and closed when the second guest enters the castle. The door B is opened right before the arrival of the third guest, and closed after the fifth one arrives. One guard can handle both doors, as the first one is closed before the second one is opened.

In the second sample case, the door B is opened before the second guest's arrival, but the only guard can't leave the door A unattended, as there is still one more guest that should enter the castle through this door.
statementZhMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6fa174fdf0ed7a199b9c338432628d2824b432fc.png)

七月底，正是 Jelly Castle 举办节日晚会的时候！来自王国各地的宾客齐聚于此，讨论糖果世界中的新潮流。然而，在这里讨论的一些事情并不应向公众透露：一旦这些信息落入不该得到它们的人手中，就可能在 Sweetland 王国引发纷争。因此，绝不能让任何未经邀请的宾客进入。

Jelly Castle 有 26 个入口，分别用大写英文字母 `A` 到 `Z` 表示。出于安全考虑，每位宾客都被指定了一个应当通过进入城堡的入口。每个入口的门会在第一位应通过该入口进入城堡的宾客到达前恰好打开，并在最后一位应通过该入口进入城堡的宾客到达后恰好关闭。不会有两位宾客同时进入城堡。

为了防止可能的入侵，每个入口都应安排一名糖果守卫。城堡中共有 $*k*$ 名这样的守卫，因此如果同时打开的门超过 $*k*$ 扇，其中一扇就会无人看守！注意，守卫必须等到自己负责的门关闭后才能离开岗位。

Slastyona 怀疑晚会上可能混入了未经邀请的宾客。她知道受邀宾客进入城堡的顺序，希望你帮助她判断是否曾经存在某个时刻，同时打开的门超过 $*k*$ 扇。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数：宾客数量 $*n*$ 和守卫数量 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{6}$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 26$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个大写英文字母 $*s*_{1}*s*_{2}... *s*_{*n}$，其中 $*s*_{*i}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 位宾客使用的入口。

## 输出格式

如果在某个时刻至少有一扇门无人看守，输出 «`YES`»；否则输出 «`NO`»。

每个字母均可任意使用大写或小写形式输出。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，入口 A 的门在第一位宾客到达前打开，并在第二位宾客进入城堡时关闭。入口 B 的门在第三位宾客到达前打开，并在第五位宾客到达后关闭。一名守卫可以负责看守这两扇门，因为第一扇门在第二扇门打开之前就已经关闭。

在第二个样例中，入口 B 的门在第二位宾客到达前打开，但唯一的守卫不能离开入口 A，因为仍有一位宾客应当通过该入口进入城堡。
